entries.scope: src/redscript/CyberpunkRealism/*.reds project-owned models/runtime classes without whole-file vanilla replacement
entries.reason: The current source is additive project-owned REDscript, shared with narrow wrapper seams. Forcing it into REDmod's vanilla-path .script replacement model would not reduce the current boundary and would create broader replacement ownership.

entries.scope: hook files enumerated in manifest/native-seams.json using @wrapMethod/@replaceMethod/@addMethod/@addField
entries.reason: These seams intentionally intercept small game-facing methods. Whole-file REDmod script replacement would copy/own substantially more vanilla implementation for the same behavior and therefore broaden patch/conflict surface. Each seam still requires exact 2.31 compile/audit evidence.

entries.scope: copying vanilla .script files from tools/redmod/scripts solely to replace current wrapper/additive hooks
entries.reason: Official REDmod supports modified vanilla-path scripts, but conflict is at file granularity and a game patch can invalidate copied implementation unrelated to Biology's narrow hook.

entries.reason: They remain transitional until an integrated REDmod-shaped replacement has compiled, packaged and deployed successfully; PKG-06 forbids premature deletion.

entries.scope: archive/pc/mod as a default Biology first-party deployment route
entries.reason: No project-original archive source currently requires the legacy root. New first-party archive content should use mods/Biology/archives.

Direct read-only probe on the supported Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 installation confirmed tools/redmod/bin/redMod.exe, file version 2.3.1.0 / product version 2.31, the deploy module, and the global -root parameter. The probe also showed REDmod's default-root heuristic can resolve incorrectly outside the game root, so deterministic tooling must pass -root explicitly.

entries.scope: actual precedence when two enabled REDmods overlap the same safe fixture file
entries.reason: Official documentation states first-listed precedence and alphabetic default ordering, but PKG-05 requires direct local evidence rather than assumption.
